hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/camp-creek-state-park-and-forest/lodging/camping-at-camp-creek-state-park/ (Mash Fork: '9 with electrical hookups', '8 with water and electric hookups', '9 with full hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 26 trailer/tent sites: 9 electric only, 8 water + electric, 9 full hookup. The park's other campgrounds (Blue Jay, tent-only; Double C, horse and rider; a hike/bike-in site) are separate.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/camp-creek-state-park-and-forest/lodging/camping-at-camp-creek-state-park/ ('the campground includes 26 trailer/tent sites with the following options'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Heated bathhouse open year-round; picnic tables, grills and fire rings at the sites.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/camp-creek-state-park-and-forest/lodging/camping-at-camp-creek-state-park/ ('Mash Fork Campground offers a heated bathhouse that is open year-round'), read 2026-10-21

min_stay.season: Thursday before Memorial Day - the day after Labor Day

values.note: Reserve online, through the West Virginia call center, by calling the park, or seasonally at the campground office (closed December through February). The two-night weekend minimum applies only from the Thursday before Memorial Day to the day after Labor Day.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/camp-creek-state-park-and-forest/lodging/camping-at-camp-creek-state-park/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights during the season on weekends starting on the Thursday before Memorial Day and ends the day after Labor Day', 'There is a 14-night maximum stay', 'The office is closed December through February'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed reservable on the WV State Parks booking site and the 14-night max; min stay narrowed to the 2-night summer weekend rule (Thursday before Memorial Day to day after Labor Day). Added water and sewer (17 of 26 sites with water, 9 full hookup), 26 sites, heated year-round bathhouse. Season (year-round) and fees ($44.99-$59.99) already recorded and consistent. Not stated: amperage, max rig length, dump.
